# Option Matrix Template

Use this structure when comparing alternatives.

| Option | Benefits | Costs and Risks | Best When | Worst When |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Option A |  |  |  |  |
| Option B |  |  |  |  |
| Option C |  |  |  |  |

## Scoring (1 low, 5 high)

| Option | Delivery Speed | Complexity | Maintainability | Cost Predictability | Vendor Lock-in | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Option A |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Option B |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Option C |  |  |  |  |  |  |

## Recommendation Pattern
1. Recommendation now.
2. Why now (top 2-3 reasons).
3. What is intentionally deferred.
4. Conditions that would change this recommendation.
